description: The CREO DLX by Globus Medical is a large diameter rod system utilizing the 6.0 and 6.35mm diameter rods. This system is primarily intended for thoracolumbar fixations where complex spinal pathologies require increased strength of the construct such as complex deformity, tumor, and trauma. The CREO DLX system also has a fenestrated screw which comes preloaded with polyaxial head.
